en: {player}! You're heading to Castelia City too, right? I'm going after Team Plasma. I'll never let them get away!
Hey, Captain! Show us this ship you're so proud of!
Ha ha! She's raring to go, but her engines went cold while I was off at the studios.
Give me a little while to warm them through, and we'll charge across to Castelia City!
Your life is your own, dear. Work hard at one thing, or try your hand at many. Just mind the people waiting on you.
Looking for the captain? He's gone off to Pokéstar Studios, of all places! Thinks he can be a star like his daughter.
